summary: OpenAI describes how it diagnosed and fixed two coincidental C++ crash bugs (a bad-hardware host and an 18-year-old race condition in GNU libunwind) affecting its Rockset-based ChatGPT data infrastructure, by building an automated population-level analysis of core dumps rather than debugging individual crashes.

practices.reason: The population-level core-dump analysis pipeline is a transferable diagnostic technique for distinguishing distinct failure populations, but it is described as the lab's own internal tooling rather than a reusable instrument.
practices.quote: The key shift was deciding that we needed to gather high-quality population data.
